name: L'AND Vineyards Relais & Châteaux
positioning: Contemporary wine retreat in Portugal's Alentejo, about an hour's drive from Lisbon, set among organic vineyards below Montemor Castle, with Sky View suites that open to the night sky
best_for: Wine lovers who want to blend their own wine and taste among the estate's organic vineyards
Couples who want a design-led suite where the bedroom ceiling opens to the stars

facts.text: L'AND Vineyards is a wine retreat about an hour's drive from Lisbon.
The resort sits in a gently sloping, south-facing valley of vineyards in the Alentejo, overlooking the skyline of the medieval Montemor Castle.
The resort is about 45 minutes from Lisbon's international airport, 4 km from Montemor-o-Novo and 20 minutes from Évora.
The resort is surrounded by six hectares of organic vineyards.
Land View Suites have a living room and a private patio with an outdoor fireplace, with views of gardens or patios.
The Lake Villas have a private pool, interiors designed by L'AND and expansive outdoor living areas.
The spa interior was designed by Márcio Kogan.
A one-hour hot-air balloon flight departs from the resort.
Horse rides go through the vineyards and olive groves with Montemor-o-Novo Castle as a backdrop.
MAPA restaurant reinterprets Portuguese cuisine through the Portuguese sea voyages, offering a new menu each season.
Café da Viagem is the wine bar, terrace and lake deck, with a view of the garden and the lake.

highlights.text: Sky View suites let guests sleep under the Alentejo night sky through an opening bedroom ceiling.
Guests can create their own personalized wine in the winery, blending Alicante, Touriga Franca, Touriga Nacional and Syrah.
The Vinothérapie Spa by Vinoble Cosmetics is set in the vineyards and uses wine by-products such as grapes, seeds, skins, pulp and stems in its treatments.
The hotel was designed by Promontório and Márcio Kogan and houses an art collection including works by Michael Biberstein inspired by the sky.
Guests can join stargazing experts with a powerful telescope for an evening watching the sky.

considerations.text: The outdoor swimming pool operates in spring and summer.
The resort is in the countryside, about an hour's drive from Lisbon.
WhataHotel notes that pricing reflects the resort's luxury positioning and exclusivity.
